functional_summary.overview: Gshare branch predictor with 7-bit PC and 7-bit global history XOR-hashed into a 7-bit index addressing a 128-entry table of 2-bit saturating counters. Contains a 7-bit global branch history register. Supports a prediction interface (Fetch stage) and a training interface (post-execution).
rules: PHT index = predict_pc[6:0] XOR global_history[6:0] for predictions; train_pc[6:0] XOR train_history[6:0] for training.
predict_taken is the MSB of the 2-bit saturating counter at the computed PHT index; predict_history is the current global history register value.
On posedge with predict_valid=1 and no training, the global history register shifts in the predicted direction (predict_taken) for the predicted branch.
On posedge with train_valid=1, the PHT counter at the training index is updated: increment (saturating at 3) if train_taken=1, decrement (saturating at 0) if train_taken=0.
On posedge with train_valid=1 and train_mispredicted=1, the global history register is recovered to train_history shifted left by one with train_taken inserted as the new LSB.
If train_valid=1 and predict_valid=1 in the same cycle, training takes precedence for the global history register update; the prediction is discarded.
If training and prediction target the same PHT entry in the same cycle, the prediction reads the pre-update PHT state (training updates PHT only at the next posedge).
Asynchronous active-high areset clears the global history register and all PHT counters to 0.
